label: OPC UA → 15-min TWA → CSV
info:
Subscribes to six ASU1 tags on the DCS's OPC UA server, computes a **time-weighted average** per 15-minute window and appends one row per window to `exports/asu1_twa_15min.csv` (host folder).

The window length is `TWA_WINDOW_MINUTES` (docker-compose.yml).
